sourceFacts.maintenance: Keep existing preparation, warnings and source order. Move the head to X centre, guide the gantry fully forward, check alignment, move the head fully right, and pluck the two belt spans separately. Adjust the two real screws with alternating equal half turns and remeasure. Conditional gantry twist remains in the existing source text; this owner does not add a new twist simulation.
sourceFacts.variants: This owner targets the classic CORE One/CORE One+ 2GT mechanism. It does not substitute Gen2/INDX GT1.5 or CORE One L geometry.

anchors.operation: Run Y around its tensioner and front pulley; pass the centre opening into the lower left opening and retain four to five protruding teeth.
Pass the centre opening into the lower right opening with four to five protruding teeth. If loosened for reach, restore the front tensioner adjustment after securing the belt.
Run X around its tensioner and front upper pulley; pass the centre opening into the right opening with four to five protruding teeth.
Pass the centre opening into the upper left opening with four to five protruding teeth.
Make all four protruding ends equal.
Fit four M3x10 screws while keeping the belt clear of their paths.
